creative_direction: Show Shikamaru Nara seated casually, his recognizable tied-up hair and narrow face clearly outlined. Use lavender irises with a few thin concentric rings around visible dark pupils. Confine the rings to the irises, preserving clear highlights and an approachable expression. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
